title: Weighting of Earlier Reductions — Group Room Blocks
content:
On Group Room Blocks, the earlier reductions counted against a reduction addendum's free-reduction allowance follow when the latest earlier reduction was made, read from the reduction entries already on the block ledger and the block's arrival date:

- when the block carries earlier reduction entries and the latest of them is dated **180 or more** calendar days before the arrival date, their room nights count at **0.5**;
- when the latest is dated **at least 120 but fewer than 180** calendar days before the arrival date, they count at **0.75**;
- when it is dated later than that, or the block carries no earlier reduction entry, they count in full.

### Questions the rule answers

**Which date decides the weight?** The date of the latest earlier reduction entry, counted in calendar days before the block's arrival date.

**Is each earlier entry weighted by its own date?** No. One weight, set by the latest entry, applies to the room nights of all the earlier reduction entries together.

**What happens at exactly 180 or exactly 120 days?** 180 days takes 0.5; 179 days takes 0.75; 120 days takes 0.75; 119 days counts in full.

### Worked weights (hypothetical earlier entries)

| Earlier reduction entries | Latest dated, before arrival | Weight | Room nights counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 200 days | 0.5 | 5 |
| 6 and 4 | 150 days (the later of the two) | 0.75 | 7.5 |
| 6 and 4 | 90 days (the later of the two) | in full | 10 |
